Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.

body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75919052/446117832/-664199346?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS84OTkxNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOWUxNDAyZS0xNGE1LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lBT5PEQZxnTQGootGNa6R6-RomUrdMWwrupXFGBcqos=)
**67 death threats and over 900 threats of online abuse.**

That’s the level of harassment DASS Chair and Colorado Secretary of State Jena Griswold faced in just a _three week_ period.

This level of violence against our election officials didn’t just happen overnight, folks. It’s been created slowly by Donald Trump and his MAGA movement over the last several years.

Friend,

I grew up right here in Toledo, and my Northern Ohio neighbors work harder than anybody I know. I think you deserve a Congresswoman who works just as hard as you do, which is why I never stopped fighting for our community this year.

Here are 23 ways that work paid off in 2023:

23 things we accomplished in 2023!
1.
We
brought
home
$1.25
million
in
federal
funding
for
a
new
TPS
Electric
Vehicle
Center
at
Toledo
Technology
Academy
of
Engineering.

2.
We
broke
ground
on
the
new
Wayman
D.
Palmer
YMCA,
a
state-of-the-art
recreation
facility
for
which
we
secured
over
$21
million
in
federal
funding.

3.
We
proudly
stood
in
solidarity
with
UAW
workers
on
the
picket
line,
winning
a
new
contract
that
guarantees
fair
wages,
better
benefits,
safer
working
conditions,
and
the
ability
to
retire
with
dignity.

We
brought
home
$10.7
million
in
funding
from
the
Bipartisan
Infrastructure
Law
to
repair
the
Northwest
Ohio
shoreline
railroad,
which
has
been
called
"the
worst
railroad
in
America."

secured
a
$1.8
million
federal
grant
for
mental
health
and
addiction
treatment
at
the
Erie
County
Health
Department.

announced
$600,000
in
CDC
funding
for
the
Junction
Coalition,
which
will
support
community
engagement,
educational
programming,
and
lead-exposure
mitigation
in
Toledo.

7.
We
introduced
the
Restoring
Communities
Left
Behind
Act,
to
deliver
millions
of
dollars
in
federal
grants
that
will
revitalize
our
communities
and
support
working
people.

8.
We
reintroduced
the
Protecting
the
Right
to
Organize
(PRO)
Act,
a
historic
bill
to
protect
workers'
rights
from
coast
to
coast.

secured
$1.9
million
in
funding
from
the

Infrastructure
Law
to
transform

Airport
to

needs.

for
and
won

for
the
Great
Lakes
Authority
in
the
Fiscal
Year
2024
budget.

reduced
the
prices
of

drugs
for

recipients
—
including
capping
the
cost
of
insulin
at
$35
per
month
—

to
President
Biden's
Inflation
Reduction
Act.

continued
to
fight
back
against
Republican
attacks
on
Social
Security
and
Medicare.

the

Office
of

and

Innovation

to
restore
American

in

like
ours.

in

communities.

nutrition
security

families

supporting
our

markets,

food
banks.

reintroduced
the
Return
to
Prudent
Banking
Act
to
reign
in
Wall
Street
and

clean_body: [] Friend, I grew up right here in Toledo, and my Northern Ohio neighbors work harder than anybody I know. I think you deserve a Congresswoman who works just as hard as you do, which is why I never stopped fighting for our community this year. Here are 23 ways that work paid off in 2023: 23 things we accomplished in 2023! 1. We brought home $1.25 million in federal funding for a new TPS Electric Vehicle Center at Toledo Technology Academy of Engineering. 2. We broke ground on the new Wayman D. Palmer YMCA, a state-of-the-art recreation facility for which we secured over $21 million in federal funding. 3. We proudly stood in solidarity with UAW workers on the picket line, winning a new contract that guarantees fair wages, better benefits, safer working conditions, and the ability to retire with dignity. 4. We brought home $10.7 million in funding from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to repair the Northwest Ohio shoreline railroad, which has been called "the worst railroad in America." 5. We secured a $1.8 million federal grant for mental health and addiction treatment at the Erie County Health Department. 6. We announced $600,000 in CDC funding for the Junction Coalition, which will support community engagement, educational programming, and lead-exposure mitigation in Toledo. 7. We introduced the Restoring Communities Left Behind Act, to deliver millions of dollars in federal grants that will revitalize our communities and support working people. 8. We reintroduced the Protecting the Right to Organize (PRO) Act, a historic bill to protect workers' rights from coast to coast. 9. We secured $1.9 million in funding from the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law to transform Put-in-Bay Airport to meet 21st-century needs. 10. We fought for and won funding for the Great Lakes Authority in the Fiscal Year 2024 budget. 11. We reduced the prices of prescription drugs for Medicare recipients — including capping the cost of insulin at $35 per month — thanks to President Biden's Inflation Reduction Act. 12. We continued to fight back against Republican attacks on Social Security and Medicare. 13. We introduced the bipartisan Office of Manufacturing and Industrial Innovation Policy Act, to restore American manufacturing in communities like ours. 14. We worked with legislators from across the aisle to improve the safety of our railways after disastrous train derailments in Ohio communities. 15. We reintroduced the Farmers Market and Food Bank Local Revitalization Act, which provides nutrition security for seniors and families while supporting our local farmers, markets, and food banks. 16. We reintroduced the Return to Prudent Banking Act to reign in Wall Street and protect the finances of working people. 17. We introduced the Child Care for Working Families Act, which would make child care affordable for working families and support higher wages for child care workers. 18. We secured a $20 million RAISE grant to improve Toledo's infrastructure and make our city safer, greener, and more walkable. 19. name: David Hogg
subject: I’m deeply worried about us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic Party of Georgia
body:
Hey Peter, can I get a minute of your time today for something important?

|
---

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75919901/446137615/227139380?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2Q2ZGQ2My0xYWE1LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYjYcYjoup1CFlGaxNzwqkW1I2-1nfQh5ODztik8POk=&emci=ef44319b-c9a4-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=43d6dd63-1aa5-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=43566853)

| | Hey Peter – thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important.

**You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place.** A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the recent mass shooting in Maine because Republican “leaders” refuse to act.

Many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy, and he is. But I believe there is an _even greater_ and _more long-term_ threat: **hopelessness.**

When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark in Virginia, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No, all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then make it not work.

I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country, and I desperately want to see us do better.

**We’re not going to fix this mess overnight.** But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them.

For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business.

**The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers.** The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate.

**We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation.**

Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

**Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically.** Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve.

**But what we do _right now_ will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass.** We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country.

**Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work.**

– If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. [_**Click here if you are fortunate enough to give $500 or more and split a donation with our partner, the Democratic Party of Georgia.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75919902/446137616/-2074411583?refcode=20231227.2_DH_12AI&amount=500&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2Q2ZGQ2My0xYWE1LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYjYcYjoup1CFlGaxNzwqkW1I2-1nfQh5ODztik8POk=)**_

– If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. [_**Click here if you think you can commit to splitting a $25 monthly donation (or something like that) between Leaders We Deserve and the GA Dems.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75919903/446137617/-2074411583?refcode=20231227.2_DH_12AI&amount=25&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2Q2ZGQ2My0xYWE1LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYjYcYjoup1CFlGaxNzwqkW1I2-1nfQh5ODztik8POk=)**_

– If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). [_**Click here to just split a one time donation of whatever you can afford.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75919904/446137618/-2074411583?refcode=20231227.2_DH_12AI&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0M2Q2ZGQ2My0xYWE1LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=SYjYcYjoup1CFlGaxNzwqkW1I2-1nfQh5ODztik8POk=)**_

– Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause.

**I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change.**

If you have any questions at all about Leaders We Deserve, please check out our website or get in touch with us on social media.

From the bottom of my heart, thank you for reading today.

\- David Hogg

# Party of the Constitution
---
Great News Michigan Republicans!
Across America, a George Soros-funded Democrat Party scheme to deny our Constitutional right to political representation was shot down by the Michigan Supreme Court.
Democrats have been attempting to prevent Donald Trump from accessing the ballot in battleground states.
The Michigan Republican Party, being represented by the American Center for Law and Justice, has filed an Amicus brief in this case.
The court affirms what Michigan law clearly states, that the political parties decide who our candidates are.
Folks, irrespective of who you support for the Republican nominee for President, if these unconstitutional actions aren’t stopped, the courts will decide who our representatives are, and we will no longer have political representation. We know these scoundrels aren’t finished attempting to usurp our Constitutional right to political representation, and the Michigan Republican Party will fight them every step of the way.
In Liberty,
Kristina Karamo ChairwomanMichigan Republican Party

subject: I have to sign off on our media plans this week

body:
My Campaign Manager, Lacey, just sent me this—I need to review and sign off on our media plans. This is a HUGE deal. Our media plans outline how much we will spend on TV and digital ads over the next 68 days before the primary.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=35488%2E3422442%2EKuDTyR)
Hey Derek,
My Campaign Manager, Lacey, just sent me this—I need to review and sign off on our media plans. This is a HUGE deal. Our media plans outline how much we will spend on TV and digital ads over the next 68 days before the primary.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231227-3?refcode=EMAO23_3_PLN_20231227_V1_F&refcode2=35488_3422442_KuDTyR&akid=35488%2E3422442%2EKuDTyR)
These won’t be set in stone this week. If we run low on funds, we’ll have to make cuts, and if we have a surge in fundraising, we can buy additional TV time or ad space.
But by approving these plans now, our campaign can lock in lower rates than we’ll pay if we’re scrambling in February, just weeks before our election. These ads will also allow us to get out in front of voters SOON, which is going to be critical.
I’ll be honest, these plans aren’t as robust as I would like. Before I give Lacey the green light, **[I wanted to see if you could make a donation of $5 to help us increase our ad buys?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231227-3?refcode=EMAO23_3_PLN_20231227_V1_F&refcode2=35488_3422442_KuDTyR&akid=35488%2E3422442%2EKuDTyR)**

I am so grateful to have you on our team!
Katie

And they didn’t let us down. They went to work and passed legislation that put shots in arms and money in pockets while also reopening schools and small businesses. They made a once-in-a-generation investment into our nation’s infrastructure — spending hundreds of millions of dollars on clean energy, high-speed internet, clean water, roads, airways, bridges, and so much more. body:
Below is an email I’m circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you.

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zaf3jul6j6iujgkmq7c5smsrj3hf23nqq7vtnfp8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)
Hi Fellow American,

Below is an email I'm circulating to outstanding leaders and principled conservatives like you. I think you may be interested in seeing it.

Please review the message at your earliest convenience and let me know if you would like to participate.

Best wishes,

Riley Gaines

P.S. The deadline is approaching to raise $1.5 million to host my upcoming college campus tour. If you'd like to give online, here's a secure link for you:
**[https://secured.leadershipinstitute.org/rgc-082424/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zfdul91gh74ql80o5vvp4eeek1c5j5fg2rd3aha8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)**

* * *

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjudc1a5c5l1s9he87mkoi9m21qebhgru430etuo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zk01r54i6eigns8d72f95ck8qhe1m8q9m099jjso_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

subject: Do you know what kids are learning in school?
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.

---
| | Hello, Are you worried about what kids are learning in school today? I know I am.

That's why I wanted to do something about it by creating the Little Patriots Program.

The Little Patriots Program provides a curriculum for grades K-5 that teaches the REAL history of America.

We provide this curriculum **free of charge** for parents, grandparents, guardians, homeschoolers, and teachers.

We are also working with conservative Hollywood producers to create a tremendous cartoon series called “Star Spangled Adventures” that helps explain each lesson in a fun and entertaining way.

We have big plans for more lessons and more cartoons, but we need your help to keep them free for those who need them.

That’s why I am emailing you today.

I have written a brand-new children’s book, [_**Red, White, and Blue: Our Flag Matters to Me and You**_](http://trk.secureandprosper._FSUxOHw), to teach kids why we stand for our American flag and the freedoms it represents.[](http://trk.secureandprosper.)
__
I wanted to send it to you for a gift of $25 or more.

All the proceeds from the book will go directly back to supporting our Little Patriots Program so we can keep making curricula and cartoons that show the history of America.

This is the easiest way to help us make sure we are giving our children the best possible resources.

Your gift of $25 or more today will help us reach more children and you’ll also receive a copy of [_**Red, White, and Blue: Our Flag Matters to Me and You**_](http://trk.secureandprosper.) with my compliments.

Sincerely,

Dr. Ben Carson

subject: Barack Obama’s revolution
body:
I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true.

| |
---
| | Fellow Patriot, America is on the brink of destruction. I don’t say this to shock or scare you – I say it because it’s true. _What we see today didn’t happen overnight. It’s the result of a movement that began with the Communist revolution in Russia and has been 100 years in the making..._ **...and Barack Obama hit the accelerator button, fast tracking their agenda.** I’d know better than most. When I was a young man, I was one of the leaders of the movement destroying America today. 50 years ago, I was a Marxist revolutionary bent on bringing America as we know it to an end. I stood side by side with Huey Newton and the leaders of the Black Panthers. I edited _Ramparts_ – radical Left's largest magazine. I marched, wrote manifestos, and attacked America whenever and however I could. Then the Panthers murdered my friend, and the Left helped the Communists win the war in Vietnam. My eyes opened to the incredible destruction and evil my “comrades” made possible. So I left and never looked back. I cast my 1984 ballot for Ronald Reagan – then I started the David Horowitz Freedom Center to fight the Left and I’ve dedicated the last 40 years to exposing them. Why? Because I knew first-hand the threat our country was facing. I knew what was at stake and I knew if I didn’t tell the American people what I knew, we would lose our country forever. That’s why I spent 6 months writing** _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_** – and I want you to have your very own copy of it. **[So I’m asking you to stand with me and make a generous, tax-deductible donation of $35 or more to my Freedom Center. As a thank you, I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zb631mr3mugjbas6krk1n94jhjrl4pss8pbc8h08_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)** When you think of “the enemy within” you may think of Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi or even Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez...and you wouldn’t be wrong. But make no mistake: **The real mastermind is Barack Obama.** Barack Obama laid the groundwork for everything we’ve seen since 2020 back in 2008. Barack Obama led the destruction of our cities, cozying up to Black Lives Matter radicals and siding with criminals over police upholding the rule of law. Barack Obama championed the castration of our military, making us a laughingstock on the world stage. And Barack Obama was the true architect behind the bogus Russian collusion witch hunt. The devastation and destruction we see today has been over a decade in the making – but most of the American people have no clue what we’re up against. **That’s why I wrote _The Enemy Within: How a Totalitarian Movement Is Destroying America_ to explain how communist and fascist Leftists infiltrated and overtook the Democrat Party...** ...how it has become a party of racism and hatred attacking the very foundations of our country... ... and how their ultimate goal is to create a one-party state – and cancel, deplatform and silence every last one of their political opponents by slandering them as “white supremacists” and worse. The reviews speak for themselves... “A Great Book” – Dinesh D’Souza “ _The Enemy Within_ is a book for all patriots who understand that our country is in a fight for its life.” – Mark Levin “David Horowitz does it again in a must-read for any American concerned about where we are headed as a nation.” Laura Ingraham I wrote _The Enemy Within_ because... I know if our country stands a chance, Americans must understand exactly how sinister and dangerous the new Democrat Party actually is. I was the enemy within — and I know in my bones what it will take to defeat them. We’ve reached the point in our history that will decide our future – and we either win these political battles or lose everything that makes us prosperous and free. **[That’s why I’ll send you a complimentary copy of The Enemy Within when you donate $35 or more to the Freedom Center today and give us the ammunition we need to expose the Left’s evil agenda to every American patriot.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z05eucqkl3bcvfn9ok1upcljgoaguv0h0nft9j1o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj6cdh2bs)** The Left is at war with America. They don’t simply disagree with us about how to make our country better – they want to destroy it to make way for their Marxist dystopia. Or in Obama’s own words “radically transform” America. **And they don’t care how much they have to lie, cheat or steal to achieve it.** So it’s up to patriots like you and me to expose the truth about the Left to our fellow Americans while we still can.
---

David Horowitz

subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z28t5ascveutbdcuml24mt283jvjf6hesji0vejg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj1c9h2bs)

____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zrn5k38cgniucbihauv3i0mv3s1hp2skcblrjob0_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj1c9h2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zuvbsq648bipg3dv240g99fb6dspgsvajegb1pdg_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm8oj1c9h2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress
---

body:
Here’s what we’re up against.

Friend,

SkyTree Book Fair and I did a deep dive and discovered the cause of why sexually explicit and disgusting books get into our children’s schools, classrooms, and libraries.

name: ICYMI News
subject: C.S. Lewis's Profound Insights
body:
C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions

| This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvld8skrunm78fpt0553685ubrj0tthr76k01a30_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z6vqitnkroli9305uids3ep1c8mb86toobb6dh1g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcq8iags3gpv49p9d4u4efq4t1uu7qh1koaame08_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zkus5g1mmht3rhhr07rq29b2d4cssvk8uja3va20_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: 1600 Daily
subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8regegsta47m1jvduev1ndnnk9e6ur0jta1e4uo_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zdejo1n5805ol2hojl12h1oa4h3o574gphig0s7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo36cthm2o71c1h2bs)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Your America
subject: Your Supreme Court survey
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College’s National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37316%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v3SE%2fIyD7p9%2bnuri3AxzDw&sysid=1)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37317%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nF766hvh3URV%2fj1lmeqCcw&sysid=1) [NO](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37318%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Dt2xiXSJKw1Yk71QFLJvbg&sysid=1) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to “pack” the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: “To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats.”

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court’s role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37319%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LA%2fvFwHmzbLzL0LrM%2fa7tg&sysid=1)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I’m sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That’s why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution” and “The U.S. Supreme Court.”

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America’s great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College’s **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37310%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=TJXoU6R9COOduOaT5kiqAg&sysid=1)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, “Big Pharma” spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today’s bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma’s reputation has come under attack in the wake of America’s opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you’ll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the “Pfizer documents,” and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You’ll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Get your copy of the 2024 Pathway to Victory Devotional today
body:
With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zliuapupmnl0i5gl8isc154ec2m0n8rdb4s6bp3g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36ctjm4p32chh2bs)
---
____ Hello Friend,

I invite you to meet the new year by studying God's Word through the brand-new 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_.

This 532-page leather-bound book is available now with our thanks for your generous matching challenge gift to support _Pathway to Victory_.

With darkness seeming to flood every aspect of our culture, the need to cling to Jesus in the coming year is more urgent than ever.

One of the ways we can stay close to the Lord is by reading His Word and maintaining a devotional time of prayer and reflection on the Scriptures.
---
| | Our annual devotional is one of the most popular resources we offer, and it makes a perfect Christmas gift. With a forest-green leather cover and inlaid wood brown and gold foil, this beautiful devotional can be used daily, providing spiritual nourishment and biblical guidance. It contains 260 devotions (Monday through Friday for all 52 weeks) written to encourage, inspire, convict, comfort, and teach you biblical truth to face the new year with spiritual readiness.
---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3eu4uqbfa10295pu5rppmmpcrcf3a9nmt26ear8_rp22sh2s8i6eo36ctjm4p32chh2bs)
---
| | We're offering the devotional as a thank-you gift to those who donate to _Pathway to Victory_ today.

Here's an outline of what we'll be studying together this year:

-- From January to February, we'll begin the year with straight talk from the Savior.
-- From March through May, we'll take a fresh look at the Holy Spirit.
-- In the summer, we'll gain wisdom from Solomon's reflections in Ecclesiastes.
-- And in the fall and winter, we'll explore 1 Corinthians together.

And the best part is that your gift of any size will be doubled in its impact thanks to the _Proclaim the Gospel_ $500,000 Matching Challenge running until December 31.

To support the work God is doing through _Pathway to Victory_ , and to receive your beautiful copy of the devotional, you can use this link: [https://ptv.org/donate/2024-pathway-to-victory-daily-devotional/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z07ddvd75cvvjhrabirkj02lh81t8c2tk0f80u5g_rp22sh2s8i6eo36ctjm4p32chh2bs).

With a donation of $300, we will send you 10 copies of the 2024 _Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional_ , a great Christmas gift for anyone!

I have no doubt that 2024 will present many challenges--globally, politically, economically, and personally--but God remains in control of all things, and our job is simply to stay close to His leading. I pray that this devotional will help you do just that.

I'm very thankful for your friendship with _Pathway to Victory_.

God bless you,
Dr. Robert Jeffress

| | | This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c13fc471d32047f2ae1f39cad3883a34&_e=wz2TSWGkRo9YFUszQh1tFdNOjcgC2WTrr-TtWnN5azY3jWFK5Ni-WVespJoIHI7PNnx4_j27l9U-BpV9hVo7ZqDtT_xxV6BEZt4z_OsiMKiDpMXKSQhe9nfFntLmqQyuSewvWJ0lNjtVgQBGycPJyyeSIXSEiBJ4AahK9UOrnfuxCunPbKbzAy5iigXkN4zcavPZnu76HMyzyIIebllsTgc-wraNWrHMQy7QpT1oCacvxmtCWkU7Kj1w_rwzI5PRulx6mTy7BufGWpmWqxxwqLataoB0q0QA8zohU8VjYLguOedoB47h1dh88HC3Q0cqPLZUjjsWCC_JXxJYY5lL9dmnc26K85OyTUUoE1db5xk8f9neKQHoxuFZFBVT4L7fNWGYNIS-1HqDW3xRHCVJ-KFO4qsafQI9onJeSSdaLGPdjyhNEFNnP0xzMKyAv5qr)

| | Dear friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That's why we produced "[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c13fc471d32047f2ae1f39cad3883a34&_e=wz2TSWGkRo9YFUszQh1tFdNOjcgC2WTrr-TtWnN5azY3jWFK5Ni-WVespJoIHI7PNnx4_j27l9U-BpV9hVo7ZqDtT_xxV6BEZt4z_OsiMKiDpMXKSQhe9nfFntLmqQyuSewvWJ0lNjtVgQBGycPJyyeSIXSEiBJ4AahK9UOrnfuxCunPbKbzAy5iigXkN4zcavPZnu76HMyzyIIebllsTgc-wraNWrHMQy7QpT1oCacvxmtCWkU7Kj1w_rwzI5PRulx6mTy7BufGWpmWqxxwqJvq_O43KTUBpa9VPordJv4PH6yigochEjn3A7UQ1aJTARNO6Z6cSLgzijGK9SVEHuvdH9mGsnuwRysrLRKjx7H1IIvUOrffKIBe3fyG4D2SAIliYg-dqiadSzrtMt7QBCFUnEeeL8hBAsND5GPOdn4fuvDUjpnIyIdHDI3qR_Ee)" which you can now own on DVD.

| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c13fc471d32047f2ae1f39cad3883a34&_e=wz2TSWGkRo9YFUszQh1tFdNOjcgC2WTrr-TtWnN5azY3jWFK5Ni-WVespJoIHI7PNnx4_j27l9U-BpV9hVo7ZqDtT_xxV6BEZt4z_OsiMKiDpMXKSQhe9nfFntLmqQyuSewvWJ0lNjtVgQBGycPJyyeSIXSEiBJ4AahK9UOrnfuxCunPbKbzAy5iigXkN4zcavPZnu76HMyzyIIebllsTgc-wraNWrHMQy7QpT1oCacvxmtCWkU7Kj1w_rwzI5PRulx6mTy7BufGWpmWqxxwqPceAtEQ4UIX4v4mP-vkqrJmYOZZhbeHf0i-FLGqQNlDUkhsjIYe5FM89J3vhpnBgvdzD9YdMp893FKP2kzhbZ6kxQ8GAt-4Qczcg03ByvjHCUFdjtTctuyifowkTHrXMpMCBwuybpwR2bcOk0RXhxFj5p8GMKCjLl1DeW5erRba)

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful new DVD box set](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c13fc471d32047f2ae1f39cad3883a34&_e=wz2TSWGkRo9YFUszQh1tFdNOjcgC2WTrr-TtWnN5azY3jWFK5Ni-WVespJoIHI7PNnx4_j27l9U-BpV9hVo7ZqDtT_xxV6BEZt4z_OsiMKiDpMXKSQhe9nfFntLmqQyuSewvWJ0lNjtVgQBGycPJyyeSIXSEiBJ4AahK9UOrnfuxCunPbKbzAy5iigXkN4zcavPZnu76HMyzyIIebllsTgc-wraNWrHMQy7QpT1oCacvxmtCWkU7Kj1w_rwzI5PRulx6mTy7BufGWpmWqxxwqLbCSJmDg4W_BWuPkwK3Sj32gclsskMmNp9A-gGhR7xxSJp5EQULsBSkQIJu50miziv0z96nWCdz-pg5tu2KuJwA-qztJmEBLE4ialtV4l6rJ8OXJr9ifr7kRhdmIWRkZIfRGKf-YqQC6OPyTYCg3aB9iIb-_KLq4jioH9QvAlFY).

Kyle Murnen, '09

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

## Michigan High Court Rules for Trump

Friend,
It's been a little more than two months since my team and I launched this campaign to flip a GOP seat in Ohio, and I've been blown away by the support.
But this is exactly when we need to keep our eyes on the prize: in purple Ohio, anything can happen with the right message delivered to the right voters.
My Trump-loving opponent is not popular, and he is not well-known. If we raise the resources we need to win, this team can deliver a historic flip and show the country that Ohio hasn't given up on democracy and no one else should, either.
We're now just days away from our first FEC report, and my opponent and his big corporate money managers will be eagerly anticipating the numbers we will report. It isn't as simple as a total, though--it is how many individuals have said "We can do this" and donated whatever they can, whether it is $5, $50, or $500.
[So, Friend, if you can, will you add your name to this grassroots effort to defeat Trumpism in Ohio and make gains here up and down the ballot? ---
My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for President of the United States.

I’m running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I’m running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I’m running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I’m doing this for my son who’s a senior in college and shouldn’t have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn’t believe in just to get an A.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I’m running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I’ve seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden’s leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a “jobs governor”** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I’ve done it before. **And I’ll do it as your next President. **

As President, I’ll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America’s future.

**[Will you join me today and help me save our country?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c688247%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JjzyMvNt%2fJYzvZnzwEhXKA&sysid=1 "Will you join me today and
help me save our country?")**

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

subject: Big Pharma and the federal government
body:
In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.
188d92cdddd40f90da47bc74ea2ba8fb

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | [](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WEwJ63S7YI0Hwg-Hq5pIow~~/AARclAA~/RgRncA6SP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2JpZy1waGFybWEtY2NhLz9zYz0wMDk0MU4wMjQyTDA2RE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249YmlncGhhcm1hJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplg2xgjWWvaLJwUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)
---
| | Dear Friend,

In America, various industries have close ties to government regulators.

The pharmaceutical industry is one of the most notable and most troubling.

Last year alone, "Big Pharma" spent over $373 million on lobbying--much more than any other industry.

While the Constitution certainly protects the rights to free speech and to petition the government, it was never intended to grant the special privileges that are characteristic of today's bureaucratic, administrative state.

In addition, Big Pharma's reputation has come under attack in the wake of America's opioid epidemic--since 1999, more than 600,000 people have died from opioid overdoses in the U.S. and Canada alone--and the COVID pandemic.

Given these current controversies, we decided to host a conference to consider the rise of Big Pharma, its role in the declining state of American health, and ideas for reform.

**The result is a free online video series that reveals the truth about Big Pharma.**

When you watch this free video series, you'll learn about the collaboration between the federal government and pharmaceutical companies, the content of the "Pfizer documents," and the origins of Big Pharma and the opioid epidemic.

You'll also gain valuable insights into Anthony Fauci and the public health establishment from Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.

**You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/big-pharma-cca/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/WEwJ63S7YI0Hwg-Hq5pIow~~/AARclAA~/RgRncA6SP0SaaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2JpZy1waGFybWEtY2NhLz9zYz0wMDk0MU4wMjQyTDA2RE9ERUVTJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249YmlncGhhcm1hJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplg2xgjWWvaLJwUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

We filmed the series at a recent Center for Constructive Alternatives conference on the Hillsdale campus. You will not have to watch for long to discover why it was one of our most popular and well-attended events.

**Please use the secure link above to receive your Big Pharma video series. When you complete the form, we will email you the series so you can watch it immediately.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844**

name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Nation Today
subject: How do you see the Supreme Court?
body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=664f24418fcb45a4a73d153a697e1d55&_e=9HwasUaGqQu9bWqk5vMdaR97pLWbK8gKmbo5iaj_NuSp9hG7uLjzOnL3d--yNOWk-kpo6TqdbRksfEBT6xVYgvZRSSfGq7eV1lwJwDyJxiPqHWjbug5ljFIwcOHnEsgaVboGTELdCGxHOsPrRGGe4gXQUPwvh69FwkI6b8LV5yds96onZck1TMfYZyqQbdvQLGGdJsX19R6LbEZsqhOl1UcpjCR0asRLp1tePRpjGu8BFJkk95xZO_HULLqRCWdIXuOB4wyyW6k9BRu7EnFjybmXtD7cYYofDEaiDiHXYxxNW8aQeFwEmFdIOYNqbpHRJQrNRly2mxF1YlS6Ey6WBdfTAKU4eufEVDrhc6dMi0Oe0HLrR4CLsiHc3jFU_f2q7pi8ZZ2nQZCKKEK3vc3Q4g%3D%3D)
---
| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=664f24418fcb45a4a73d153a697e1d55&_e=9HwasUaGqQu9bWqk5vMdaR97pLWbK8gKmbo5iaj_NuSp9hG7uLjzOnL3d--yNOWk-kpo6TqdbRksfEBT6xVYgvZRSSfGq7eV1lwJwDyJxiPqHWjbug5ljFIwcOHnEsgaVboGTELdCGxHOsPrRGGe4gXQUPwvh69FwkI6b8LV5yds96onZck1TMfYZyqQbdvQLGGdJsX19R6LbEZsqhOl1UcpjCR0asRLp1tePRpjGu8BFJkk95xZO_HULLqRCWdIdmVhQzfPK2m8yQZGgF3EAJGqM4OZ_HvZN53Xgb6ag2-2jKNdaTGcq3VDtV92tlADp_HzmjohxF1NgPvyd6KntjSReUaboEU4aWtDfvhbwc9kOqEvg2KPYuuUym2s28_faO_Rp2xyv3jDlHlrS_eArg%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=664f24418fcb45a4a73d153a697e1d55&_e=9HwasUaGqQu9bWqk5vMdaR97pLWbK8gKmbo5iaj_NuSp9hG7uLjzOnL3d--yNOWk-kpo6TqdbRksfEBT6xVYgvZRSSfGq7eV1lwJwDyJxiPqHWjbug5ljFIwcOHnEsgaVboGTELdCGxHOsPrRGGe4gXQUPwvh69FwkI6b8LV5yds96onZck1TMfYZyqQbdvQLGGdJsX19R6LbEZsqhOl1UcpjCR0asRLp1tePRpjGu8BFJkk95xZO_HULLqRCWdIaufZkIu8vAwFO-v_YWSCOMULvNi-8-AN601VLkooB5v5r6qYbmJSj6ByH81AbeLJKZgp3UEifwhBQ-Yq8msMfGPz8PBltra_sPiqlyiitS0RpLZp4BEQ1ToLtCtZ11fsVk4MInodfi8-3cSdd3WYMA%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=664f24418fcb45a4a73d153a697e1d55&_e=9HwasUaGqQu9bWqk5vMdaR97pLWbK8gKmbo5iaj_NuSp9hG7uLjzOnL3d--yNOWk-kpo6TqdbRksfEBT6xVYgvZRSSfGq7eV1lwJwDyJxiPqHWjbug5ljFIwcOHnEsgaVboGTELdCGxHOsPrRGGe4gXQUPwvh69FwkI6b8LV5yds96onZck1TMfYZyqQbdvQLGGdJsX19R6LbEZsqhOl1UcpjCR0asRLp1tePRpjGu8BFJkk95xZO_HULLqRCWdIIGQHROcnuG8lZl-fjEs_7FIQIkACK3wwDBJl_R9MKQSrV7Z8cIm2ffmyzftmfXtghe3ODgwUJIv9gOnLGA4pfubA93CnN1LWAOcH_pKBU6SpeGpKlLyyIsHM9sYo2bv30u9lM26vaCgbPKVNnisD9A%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

That means all of our work--including reaching and teaching millions about America's great heritage of liberty--depends entirely on the support of Americans like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.

Please share your thoughts with Hillsdale using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court **right away--the link is below.

[**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=664f24418fcb45a4a73d153a697e1d55&_e=9HwasUaGqQu9bWqk5vMdaR97pLWbK8gKmbo5iaj_NuSp9hG7uLjzOnL3d--yNOWk-kpo6TqdbRksfEBT6xVYgvZRSSfGq7eV1lwJwDyJxiPqHWjbug5ljFIwcOHnEsgaVboGTELdCGxHOsPrRGGe4gXQUPwvh69FwkI6b8LV5yds96onZck1TMfYZyqQbdvQLGGdJsX19R6LbEZsqhOl1UcpjCR0asRLp1tePRpjGu8BFJkk95xZO_HULLqRCWdI3iBdD_wj3QzQtgDJKAMLnAp1xUxT-2k52ESv6MZIZoTJsxxN3gWv7LsOaJRLrj3yPEMgLVIHDpi4yLpCqAsmgsIePToQzSG8-RVi5n4BTZz0ij4ghBPXMVFNQ4oe5kLcnH23hBd5bavaFgooX4j-Rg%3D%3D)

Then please consider giving a generous tax-deductible gift to preserve liberty for future generations through education.

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth - Defending Liberty since 1844

subject: Almost there...
body:
Dear Peter,

There are only __68 days__ until Primary Election Day, and only __49 days__ until Early Voting Begins.

Victory is so close! We're almost there!

I'm not asking you to make a large donation at this time, especially not just after Christmas. But I am asking for you to make a small but significant contribution to my campaign.

**_My campaign is a coalition of patriots, conservatives, God-fearing and America-loving citizens just like you. If each of you send me $68 or $49 TODAY, we can meet our year-end goal!_**

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/q4_deadline)

The world is on fire. Congress is broken.

Career politicians with their own agenda, lobbyists representing special interests, and twenty-somethings are running our country. The Swamp is uglier, more corrupt, and grossly more ineffective than it's ever been.

_I 'm Christian Castelli. I'm not a career politician breaking my term limit pledge to seek my next opportunity. I'm not a lobbyist pushing the Big Insurance agenda. I'm a retired Lieutenant Colonel in the U.S. Army, decorated combat veteran, Green Beret, and senior advisor at the Pentagon. _

My campaign is $2,961 short of my year-end of fundraising goal. I need to meet this target.

**Please make a contribution of $68 or $49 TODAY!**

We can't allow Joe Biden to be reelected. And we can't allow Democrats to control Congress. My election to this Democrat-held seat can grow the Republican majority.

We can put a stop to Bidenomics and inflation. We can close and secure our border. We can once again project American strength through peace around the globe and send terrorist into hiding.

Let's send an experienced, proven, and conservative Green Beret to Congress. Career politicians or lobbyists won't get the job done!

**We are just $2,961 short of our fundraising goal. But if you make a donation of $68 or $49, we can and we will win this campaign. Please make a donation TODAY!**

[****](https://secure.winred.com/committee-to-elect-christian-castelli/q4_deadline)

****

Christian Castelli
Lieutenant Colonel (Retired)
U.S. Army Special Forces
Republican Candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Dear Peter,
This headline says everything you need to know:
* * *
[](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_12_28_23_email_1rs_2_nd&n=4)
* * *
**Despite threats, despite my family history...President Joe Biden is denying Secret Service Protection for me.**
This third rejection by the Administration is a travesty.
The implications are unmistakable: I am personally at much greater risk; as is my family and close staff, and our campaign is on the hook for security detail that costs us thousands of dollars that could otherwise be used to garner ballot access.
Only one thing will stop the political elites from having their way. It’s called people power.
Our grassroots supporters have funded our campaign, which is forced to hire private security (which already stopped an armed intruder with a Federal Marshal badge from entering an event.)
**If you want to help stop the dirty trick of denying Secret Service protection from succeeding,** [please donate to my campaign.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_12_28_23_email_1rs_2_nd&n=5)
[And there is no better time that right now—we’re closing in on the end of the year and our huge goal of raising $6 million dollars—and we are getting extremely close to reaching that goal.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=secret_12_28_23_email_1rs_2_nd&n=6)
Thank you again for all you have done, and will do, to take our campaign to the next level! Together we will heal this great nation, build bridges, and unite as one to restore honesty and integrity to Washington.

| [ ](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58727?t=6&akid=12208%2E878179%2EYIoMpI) James Carville here, folks, and I’m personally reaching out tonight because I’M F&$%ING TERRIFIED.

[**I need to ask you to split an urgent donation between Jon Tester’s campaign and the Voter Protection Project NOW and stop that no-good Mitch McConnell from buying Montana’s Senate seat.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58727?t=7&akid=12208%2E878179%2EYIoMpI)

Mitch and his super PAC buddies have raised BONKERS amounts of money in the past year to stop Jon by any means necessary. And if they’re successful, Democrats can kiss their majority goodbye. **BOOM: national abortion ban, lower wages, your health care gutted.**

Jon needs your help like, yesterday. Hell, even if you already gave yesterday, he needs you to give again.

Because here’s the deal about this MASSIVE fundraising deadline, folks— _we ain’t there yet._ **And guess what?! ALL donations will help protect the Dem majority. Isn’t that worthwhile?**

[**We need an extra push to get us across that finish line, and I know we can do it together. Split an urgent contribution of $10 (or more if you’re feeling spicy!) between Jon’s campaign and the Voter Protection Project to help reelect Jon and double your impact:**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58727?t=8&akid=12208%2E878179%2EYIoMpI) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58728?t=9&akid=12208%2E878179%2EYIoMpI)

Here’s the deal. If we lose Montana, it’s GAME OVER. Mitch McConnell and his far-right cronies would snatch back Senate control and wreck our country with their extremist agenda. That’s why he’s so focused on beating Jon, and why Sunday’s deadline means EVERYTHING for the campaign.

**Jon Tester is Democrats' only chance to hold this seat and protect our Senate majority. But ONLY with your support.**

[**So click that donate button, put the pedal to the metal, and let’s win this thing for our future, our families, and our country.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/58727?t=14&akid=12208%2E878179%2EYIoMpI)
Thanks, y’all.

—James Carville

From: Riley Gaines <rileygaines@email.leadershipinstitute.org>
Send Date: August 9, 2023 9:55 AM
Subject: Did you see my announcement?

Dear Friend,

I hope you saw my announcement on Sean Hannity's show that I've partnered with the Leadership Institute to launch the Riley Gaines Center.

I'm the 12-time All-American swimmer who speaks out against transgender ideology and fights to defend basic truths - that men are men and women are women.

The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute is now the exclusive headquarters of my work to lead conservatives of all types - patriots who will not be silenced by the weight of the left's cultural pressure and who want to learn how to defend America's freedoms.

When the left tries to shout you down profanely, when they viciously attack you - that's when you know you're saying the right things.

For those who are attacked, vilified, and persecuted for their support of America's founding principles and traditional American values, the Riley Gaines Center sends a message that they are not alone - because I will stand bravely with them.

To train as many young people as I can to stand up for conservative principles, I must have the help of strong Leadership Institute supporters like you.

**[Will you help turn young men and women into Leaders for America?](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Z9NFqdTN2ABLF3dNTzv_iw~~/AARclAA~/RgRncCqyP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplg3Z8jWXlt24VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

The Riley Gaines Center is the exclusive home of my work to lead this crucial cause through:

* Speaking events and media appearances to rally everyday Americans to defend women's identity and uphold vital truths.

* A coalition of women, student athletes, parents, and those who have been harmed by radical transgender ideology, to join me in speaking out across the country.

* A fast-growing team of speakers and grassroots organizers, who will help turn those ready to defend freedom into champions who put their principles into action.

---
Through the Riley Gaines Center, my fellow Leadership Institute colleagues and I will identify, recruit, train, mentor, and empower students, athletes, and parents across the country to become campus, community, and national Leaders for America.

Not only will these young leaders help our country right now. They will stand up for our principles for decades to come.

**[By joining me and the Leadership Institute team with your contribution to this new effort, you make a powerful difference for conservatives across the country, from college campuses to the halls of power.](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Z9NFqdTN2ABLF3dNTzv_iw~~/AARclAA~/RgRncCqyP0SUaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmxlYWRlcnNoaXBpbnN0aXR1dGUub3JnL3JnYy0wODI0MjQvP3V0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1yaWxleV9hcHBlYWwmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PVYyLVBBLVJPTi0yMDIzMTIyOFcDc3BjQgplg3Z8jWXlt24VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)**

Thank you for your support and dedication to preserving commonsense truths and conservative principles in our country.

Stand bravely with me,

Riley Gaines
The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

The Leadership Institute, 1101 N. Highland St., Steven P.J. Wood Building, Arlington, VA 22201, United States

---

Restore Our Nation

Dear Friend,
As we get ready to close the books on 2023 and get the 2024 campaign cycle officially started, our campaign wanted to share with everyone the top reasons to support Shamaine Daniels for Congress in PA-10.
Midnight on 12/31 is our final fundraising deadline of the year, and we’re asking for your help to reach our year-end online fundraising goal . As we do, we wanted to remind our supporters why Shamaine Daniels is the candidate you need to support if you want to defeat insurrectionist Scott Perry in 2024.
If you already support Shamaine Daniels for Congress, please help us reach our fundraising goal and CLICK HERE to contribute before midnight on 12/31 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Without further ado, the number three reason to support Shamaine Daniels for Congress in PA-10 is her deep connection to the community.
Shamaine is a longtime resident of the district, but she’s more than just a resident. Shamaine is a leader in the community. Now in her third term as a member of Harrisburg City Council, Shamaine has spent ten years serving many of the constituents that she wants to serve in Congress.
As an elected official, Shamaine understands the responsibility of governing better than any Democratic candidate in the race. As a member of the City Council, Shamaine has helped to pass budgets and address real problems. As a municipal official, Shamaine and her colleagues don’t have the option to shut down city government when they disagree. Instead, they work together to get the job done because they know their constituents are counting on them.

| | | | **The kids are not alright.**
❌ Gun violence has become the leading cause of death for children.
❌ Child poverty has more than doubled in the last two years and millions of children go hungry every day.
❌ The climate crisis is driving up childhood asthma rates, threatening our water supplies, and is an existential threat to future generations.
❌ Millions of children lack adequate and affordable healthcare — at one of the most critical times of their development.
❌ Millions of children in the US attend underfunded public schools.

**If we want Congress to get serious about solving these problems, we must elect a Kids First Majority in 2024.**

name: Chuck Schumer
subject: The most important race in 2024
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Friend, the most important race happening in 2024 isn't just the race for the White House. It's the race for Senate control.
The future of everything we care about – from health care and voting rights to abortion rights – will depend on who holds the Senate majority after the election. That's why I'm writing to you today.
With the retirement of Sen. Joe Manchin, we could hold every single seat we have and still lose Senate control. That's why it's so imperative that we help Colin Allred defeat Ted Cruz in Texas.
Polls are showing these two neck and neck, and Ted Cruz is the most vulnerable GOP senator in the country. We can win this race, but the GOP knows it too – they're preparing to pour millions of dollars into Texas to lie about Colin's record and try to stop us.
Friend, if we can match the GOP's millions, we can win in Texas and virtually guarantee our Senate majority. But if Colin misses his fundraising goals, we'll lose the best chance we have to secure Senate control. Please, I'm personally asking: Will you split a donation of $25 or more between Colin Allred and Serve America to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Democratic Senate majority?! [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Thank you.
Chuck

| | | Trump's trial date is set for March 4 in the federal case re: his attempts to overthrow the 2020 election. Special counsel Jack Smith is asking the court to prevent Trump from making political attacks during the trial. We've seen the way Trump has already attacked people involved in the case, and there's no doubt he'll unleash his hatred and vitriol in the courtroom in front of a jury. So the prosecution is asking that the court "not permit the defendant to turn the courtroom into a forum in which he propagates irrelevant disinformation, and should reject his attempt to inject politics into this proceeding." Jack Smith is also calling for Trump to be barred from claiming he is being prosecuted only for political reasons: "In addition to being wrong, these allegations are irrelevant to the jury's determination of the defendant's guilt or innocence, would be prejudicial if presented to the jury, and must be excluded." The jury should be able to hear a case based on facts, not Trump's baseless attacks and lies. We need the court to put restrictions in place so Trump cannot turn the courtroom into a circus.
