subject: Important Food Shortage Notice
body:
Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent...

**The Truth About The Coming Food Crisis** **This might be your only warning.** According to official reports, dangerous global events have reached America, putting the entire nation in harm's way. Despite this imminent crisis, mainstream media remains silent... And our own government ignores dire warnings of industry experts like fourth-generation American farmers who warn: **_" Food shortages are coming."_** Imagine the panic of seeing empty grocery store shelves, not for a few days, but for several weeks or even months. The loss will be beyond what you can imagine. **As a result of this crisis, survival food is more important than ever.** If you don't take action or if you stockpile the wrong foods, you could be setting your family up to go hungry in a time of crisis. It sounds harsh, but the truth is too many people with good intentions are making critical mistakes with their survival food. Mistakes like...
* Getting MREs with a 5-year shelf life - depending on where you purchase them from they could be near expired...
* Getting gross survival foods that are tough to stomach and so high in salt, MSG and preservatives you could clog your arteries and get yourself sick...
* Or simply getting the wrong foods and leaving a critical hole in your meal plan, which means you risk becoming malnourished...

**Well, no need to worry anymore.** Obviously, waiting for the government to give me a handout in a disaster just wasn't an option for me. And I was completely turned off by the crazy high cost of survival food sold by some companies. That's why I ordered and got my very own stockpile of these best-selling [**Survival Food Kits**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z85v2ne190bmmsssil58c9so0hi9rkep54403m18_rp22sh2s8i6eo36ctie8o70cth2bs). When you secure your own food stockpile, you will have the peace of mind and security knowing that when a crisis hits... You will be able to calmly reassure your family that they're safe and they will have plenty to eat. [**Click here to secure your own stockpile of these best-selling survival food kits while you still can.**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znsb1p06ea1d7uhj1df2n6di55adouk4ibutskko_rp22sh2s8i6eo36ctie8o70cth2bs) When a crisis hits, the masses begin to panic, and grocery stores are wiped out. # Experts are warning of an impending attack on our power grid!! Are you prepared?
---
|
---
| As I prepare for 2024, there is one main thing on my mind: the United States power grid.
Experts from many different fields are concerned about the stability of our power grid and the possibility of an attack. I've talked with people from the intel community, military leaders, executives from the energy sector, and others. I can tell you that all of them are preparing their households to live through a major power outage. When I say "major" I mean major. Some scenarios could leave us without power for a few _years_.

Have you contemplated what a major disruption to our power supply could look like for you and your family? The power being out means no gas pumps to fuel your cars, no refrigerator, no heater, or air conditioning, no internet, and on and on I could go. After some time it would also mean no grocery stores, no cell phones, no ability to travel or communicate, etc. If these experts are right, we're heading into some scary times.

As I've listened to all the experts talking about this very real threat, I've assessed what I can do. Obviously, I needed to prepare my own home and family. I've done that. Next, I thought through ways I could help _**you**_.

I wanted to reach out to you with a resource that will help ease your worries and empower you to navigate through a major power outage or disaster of any kind. Introducing my brand new book, [_**"Grandpa Bill's Step-by-Step Guide to Thriving In The Apocalypse"**_](https://RachelHamm.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b2a4361c438b0f1b15ed7ec95&id=761e6de778&e=5fa0631807 ""Grandpa Bill's Step-by-Step Guide for Thriving in the Apocalypse"")– a comprehensive manual that provides practical insights and invaluable advice on how to not just survive but thrive in the face of power grid disruptions and other apocalyptic scenarios. This carefully crafted guide draws on the wisdom of my Grandpa Bill, a seasoned survivor of World War II and the Great Depression. He had a wealth of experience in navigating challenging times. Why should you consider this guide? Here are just a few reasons:
1. **Expert Guidance:** During these unstable times you really need to hear from someone who knows what to do! My grandpa taught me information and skills that will be extremely useful in the face of a catastrophic event, like a power grid failure. In this new book I share the things he taught me so that _YOU_ can know what to do.
Grandpa Bill's years of practical experience makes this book a treasure trove. You don't want to be left to figure this all out on your own!
2. **Practical Tips:** From establishing your own food and water supply to the different kinds of medical supplies, guns, and survival items you might want to buy, this guide offers step-by-step instructions to ensure you're well-prepared for whatever challenges may come your way.
3. **Gain Confidence:** Reading this book will give you confidence. It can be daunting to know how to prepare for a major power outage. In this book, I'll give you the information you need to feel confidently prepared. Reading this book and doing what it says will give you peace of mind!

Don't miss out on the opportunity to gain invaluable insights into thriving during uncertain times. Thank you for considering "Grandpa Bill's Step-by-Step Guide to Thriving In The Apocalypse" as your go-to resource for preparedness. Together, let's face the future with confidence and resilience.

| | | | | Peter – I’ve worked in politics for half a century, so believe me when I tell you: **Democrats are in BIG trouble.** The 2024 Senate map is the toughest one I’ve ever seen. Our razor-thin majority is hanging on by a single thread, and there’s no question that Mitch McConnell and his extremist cronies will use every trick up their sleeves to snatch back power.**** **The GOP is coming at us with full force – and with experts saying that Nevada could once again decide Senate control, they’re zeroing in on Jacky Rosen as a TOP target for defeat. Now, brand new polling shows the Nevada Senate race in a statistical dead heat!!! It’s not looking good, Peter.** [**Jacky needs to raise another $3,000 by midnight tonight to fight back against GOP attacks and fuel her campaign forward – but the ONLY way she can get there is with your immediate grassroots support. So PLEASE, will you split a $20 donation between her campaign and Blue Amp Action right now?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcf5826f4-06a9-4402-974e-6a53dc63b80a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Democrats won in Nevada by less than 1% last year, making it the closest Senate race in the entire country. Now that they have a second chance at winning in Nevada, Republicans aren’t going to leave anything up to chance – and they’re already pulling out all of the stops to flip this seat. **If Jacky loses in Nevada, McConnell and his far-right posse will take back the majority and enact their dangerous, out-of-touch agenda. We CANNOT let this happen.** In my expert opinion, we CAN win this race and keep control of the Senate – but that starts with raising the resources, today, to prepare for the tough fight ahead. [**So please, Peter, I’m asking you one more time before the midnight deadline: Will you chip in as much as you can spare to Jacky’s campaign and Blue Amp Action now to help her win in Nevada and defend our majority?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta34b81ba-fff0-4c34-a1e7-c9f0f22e4192/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **** Thank you for being part of this incredible team. I’ve seen many grassroots campaigns in my lifetime, and I know this one has what it takes to win. James Carville

body:
The border crisis is far worse than we imagined.

Peter, we just went down with Republican Max Ukropina to the southern border in San Diego to learn firsthand about the border crisis from the front lines.

It's far worse than we imagined.

Did you know there's a literal GAP in the border wall that illegal immigrants can walk right through? We watched over a dozen people cross over in a matter of minutes!

In fact, we put together a video documenting what we saw.

We hope you have a few minutes to check it out ... we HAVE to start putting America First at our southern border. **And when I say everyone, I mean _everyone._** Dark money GOP super PACs, extreme right wing groups, and national Republican megadonors are watching, especially now that we’ll be entering an election year.

Posting strong numbers, including the total number of grassroots donors who support this important work, will showcase the strength and momentum behind taking back the House and putting Democrats in charge.

Let me explain:

We’re about to enter a critical election year. The amount that we raise right now will help determine how strong our momentum can be as we start 2024, and how much we can invest in campaigning for our plans.

We not only have to spend the next year fighting back against MAGA extremism — but also against a system that benefits from the status quo and says that big change is "impossible."

That’s why I’m running for re-election — to stop MAGA extremism, build on the progress we’ve made so far, and deliver the big, structural change our country still needs.

I’m talking with people across Massachusetts about the issues affecting their families and campaigning for bold policies that will transform the lives of working people across the country.

Policies like creating affordable child care and housing. Holding big corporations accountable and bringing down costs. Reimagining our tax code to support working families.

But in order to make these plans possible, Democrats have got to hold onto the Senate. Pundits, strategists, and special interests will look for any signs of weakness as they plan on where to invest in 2024. That’s why it’s incredibly important that we hit all of our grassroots fundraising goals right now so we can run a strong campaign for our plans.

**[So before the end-of-year fundraising deadline, can you please split a contribution of $5 or anything you can between my campaign and the DSCC to ensure we hit our December 2023 goals, defend our Senate majority, and prepare to campaign for big, structural change in 2024?](https://go.dscc.org/go/12679?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20231228-ElizabethWarren-WarrenTandemDec-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20231228-ElizabethWarren-WarrenTandemDec-Pros-sl1&akid=13041%2E9716520%2EOycBqW)**

Elizabeth

A boy who couldn't wait to serve his country and a man who knows the meaning of sacrifice.

A boy who wanted to be just like his dad and a man who has three children of his own.

A boy whose family worked hard to make ends meet and a man who's running for the U.S. Senate.

Friend, a lot has changed since the 80's, but one thing has stayed the same: I still know that God put me on this earth to serve my country.

My name is Sam Brown. I'm a retired Army Captain, a father, a conservative, and a Christian.

And most recently, I'm a candidate for Nevada's U.S. Senate seat.

But one thing I'm not is a politician -- in fact, I've never held elected office in my life.

That means that I'm not beholden to special interests or corrupt D.C. elites.

**But it also means that I don 't have the big money megadonors that are fueling my opponents' campaigns.**

That's why I'm reaching out to you, Friend.

I don't need special interests to fund our campaign.

I don't need big money megadonors.

I don't need D.C. elites.

**All I need is YOU, Friend.**

Here's how you can help me win this Senate seat:

**1 - Your Prayers:** Running for the U.S. Senate is a tremendous undertaking. It's something that I can't do all by myself. I'd be honored and humbled to be included in your prayers as I take on this tremendous challenge to serve the country I love.

**2 - Your Voice:** This is going to be an all-out effort. Sharing my posts on social media or forwarding this email to a few friends will go a long way in ensuring that my message reaches Americans far and wide.

**3 - Your Donation:** Friend, I know things are tough right now. Joe Biden's failed economy has everyone counting their pennies, but what might seem like a small donation to you is monumental to me. **[If you have $5, $10, $15, or even $20 to spare](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8af9537818e641289537c892aae6c287&_e=ErC8SoZcYWBH1yQ7Yo66_4TLZINCHA76fzxhBHvBJZAhDnMOtv5Gmahlq6I2L5niIw-o3ck_-1ZTFxJkPaBPoK0YuX8KPQACSkvop2WlPHV2WLxrZUY1vGUhMQoX4Hd7hXbo1Nj67RIAbG_3JYnPo6XK8l-QGJtuIBwvb6ON2wh3Y9m2YhZ2eYdy9gqdfPycRYzm2vsc3zvlfYnWEeOxOc9E57pCFoouqTovrrxo6WWiXE9GKbOalwQ_3U8pWnGmYrrId_6DFGz9vIt4idbAECeuHcuqlOuv9EV-dBCz3FARy2ltHognOIpTy-87FM3Ng2br7ZTZ0A64-6WCnFWj1g%3D%3D "If you have $5, $10, $15, or even $20 to spare")** , it would go a long way toward helping this campaign.

Friend, together, we can show the D.C. establishment that they can't buy this Senate seat.

**[Can I count on your support?](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=8af9537818e641289537c892aae6c287&_e=ErC8SoZcYWBH1yQ7Yo66_4TLZINCHA76fzxhBHvBJZAhDnMOtv5Gmahlq6I2L5niIw-o3ck_-1ZTFxJkPaBPoK0YuX8KPQACSkvop2WlPHV2WLxrZUY1vGUhMQoX4Hd7hXbo1Nj67RIAbG_3JYnPo6XK8l-QGJtuIBwvb6ON2wjH5r-_AYSQRtVTEutRgW0hzqqMI-l4lmpOxv_3nPCdYUovko9kyocMwv_B4KYTFuVhknvPmS2xv3hUXs1t-S0TEA0_wztc-gVkv-H0ZSU06k-GgW0PQbVsJ5dlmzgYM3vLAGIwHEwgWMb_SrfpMxCd2gT-uWFd3O9YtqHZ_8Q9UQ%3D%3D "Can I count on your support?")**

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: Please give me a chance to explain
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter -

At the end of this email, I'm going to ask you to [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231228-1-io.Mo0Nbo&refcode=em20231228-32543&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1001&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR ]split a contribution
— of $3 or anything you can — between Justice Democrats and
my re-election campaign. Before I do, I hope you'll give me a minute of
your time to explain why your support is so important.

Here's the deal, Peter:

December is an important month for political campaigns across the country,
but that's especially true for ones like ours, who are powered by lots and
lots of small-dollar, grassroots contributions, chipped in by people
giving what they can.

That's because at the end of the month, we're facing an official FEC
fundraising deadline — the final one before 2024, when this race will
truly begin to heat up.

We've written to you about these deadlines before, but I mean it when I
say this is a big one. In the days after this deadline passes, our team is
legally required to publicly report our fundraising numbers for the year.

That means how much we've raised, but more importantly, how many
individual contributions we've received. Good or bad, no matter what, for
all to see.

I can guarantee you that everyone — from AIPAC and the right-wing super
PACs to our primary challengers and the media — will be among the very
first looking through the receipts.

They're going to use these public reports to see if our movement is
showing any signs of weakness, or if we have the grassroots strength to
take them on and fight back as we've always done.

The only way we're funding this campaign is together, and we need to
report the strongest numbers we possibly can to show there is nothing that
will slow us down.

That's why your support, Peter
— along with the support of countless progressives standing in solidarity
all across the country — is so important. Especially today.

So please:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231228-1-io.Mo0Nbo&refcode=em20231228-32543&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1002&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR ]Can you split a contribution — of $3 or any amount you
can — to stand with Justice Democrats and me today? Each and every
contribution, no matter the size, means so much ahead of this month's FEC
deadline.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20231228-1-io.Mo0Nbo&refcode=em20231228-32543&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=3&t=1021&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR ]Contribute $3

When I think of the many, many reasons I'm so proud of our movement, one
of them is the way we fund our campaigns. I hope you're proud of that
too, Peter.

Thanks for chipping in, and for everything you do.

In solidarity,

Ilhan

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time.

There are other ways to make an impact in support of peace and equality in
Israel and Palestine: please urge your member of Congress to support a
ceasefire through [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139873?t=1022&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR ]Adalah Justice Project’s petition or by calling them
using [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/139874?t=1023&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR ]Jewish Voice for Peace’s dialer here. Your voice matters in this
critical moment.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20231228-32543-footer&t=1024&refcode2=32543_1203867_kDH3iR&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1025&akid=32543%2E1203867%2EkDH3iR

PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee.
Justice Democrats
1390 Columbia Ave #261
Lancaster PA 17603
Email us: us@justicedemocrats.com

| | If you want to help The Collective PAC build Black political power up and down the ballot, and across the country, then you’re in the right place. If you'd like to unsubscribe [click here.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnl7NBjmTZL5F5oqdT0MFW4GJFfovgZaqyhL6oVedQTvxqf62j1-674ssdeYZmJRYBzWSHitiKSzbPsrpv-_hwFxmusDClMi_fBQryOBnrEe8VpEZMbFp7jU3DRv-6lydxj5XtttZOrzFi6m5DmC6HUHlG_9YlqZjV6sW9GqGynj4RH25R6LB14XvW9wLR-r7H5onpzUR_emmPFmEQc6u5Wet80zqfgvTSXa6Mr6TXsvTZOG1RZ0iNU1O-FS66x3Z2hh8Omh7zAA3PCjdoC5WFTi-V3G4oO0vgBKOojqKMEHlYiffDhJI0zdSdGDTAnSFK1TzbsX-abfzajf5-jqEgJWzPfPTjQ2TKX7n4kgFjozWjbJQratMlRXt9PIyhMc5niUjuHOkp6xcJCNzzIaInWKdxDgcw2Hu9Y4J6JVx0xquNJPFwUTRkD3u0dIILIii14/42i/RsNEfciOSi615Y8Km_PzGg/h0/JhwKaFInClHoILAAuKNbLTq-0TpqIZDtgd8RrZyx_9k) | | [](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZLt3B3YmMzfTeaUv6D3l9TDms7SZmz4-Gf7x7MJr2Ctlr-opRgY4490yccjjnqAwY_vTHcQ6i0ukj0oxO2qizjL4l5uSU3Z9QBHpmw1uor6s5pJ3_Ik-rQSIlrVM3XwoxZcMrzrDti8Ek0Bpn6UEcbwCjeWnq7cdt1s40hhct0yBZ7FnbOzpREgiY9a5PKcPd3fNDqqFTr9371kU8W8s54CscL8TglbRtKe34vr-kkWi0IANuXFbUanToLDkxJpv39WcVsBUXoQxkLfD_P2Zn0y-s2h5DMG2tVR-wcIGjNNQVz_rBbwjQ5jNNHgOv_zIpNd8JwPhu5RC9vmTj6c4hKk-PiNvnGJdd0bvNU7WJsuNUa9VH_0SBFBILTz6yYsZG/42i/RsNEfciOSi615Y8Km_PzGg/h1/Y0QAek07gwaSuco9zb3eonhgZWJYwIAJZRtIJs11aj8) California has had a lot of governors, Peter. **My story is nothing like theirs.**

My name is Tony Thurmond. I’m a proud father, Afro-Latino, and long-time public servant who’s fought for Californians on my local school board, city council, in the state assembly and for the last five years as state superintendent – running the largest public education system in America.

The importance of service was ingrained in me by my mother, Cecelia. She was an immigrant from Panama and a classroom teacher. When I was just 6 years old, she died tragically, and my brother and I became orphans.

We were raised by our cousin. We were poor. We knew what hunger was and had to rely on food stamps. **But public education was our great equalizer. It’s what enabled an orphan with no money, power or influence to grab on to opportunities and build a pathway to a better life.**

**I’ve spent my life fighting to ensure all Californians have those opportunities – which is why I’m running to be the next governor of California.[If you believe this state should be a place where everyone can succeed, then please split a donation of $10 between my campaign and The Collective PAC right now.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZobNI0IyJvNQ6wMx-qo2oDxkEAil2luSyUsJAz68Oa4hc6L2AVt1zktQh9qhkjhCU2zdzYlO6k5RnyADs2LyYLz3MByowxNGe4zVtjziG-2rPfx1KkZ8fRrvE3tQRmWN3yrdVNwF0La-ZM5SydnzwXHCkB3QTllU5sQQAbstzs5pMCqjzsUgBPP5pEH4gt1cBiZtp_a0Imvqvj-eJha1LdORxH35OkCuiO7Xo1WfDoiRW795-eQvqR0VijwWfMFyz1hiNYBNnKQPtijSyszIbYbINzXccO8widmsuLJ1XLIAO9k-8Xt7wvJah-l_DeX0MhjcOSIN05T9JyjWvwBBF53qKJARRyT49hYpUeGr1DiEaBPUgFF9nNYej3oYL259D/42i/RsNEfciOSi615Y8Km_PzGg/h2/0ha64QlDpG3kx4VOQ6tvp5bBbarNtDWkTQYvrpZ2DG8)**

Across our country, the very fabric of who we are as a society is being tested. California is the fifth largest economy in the world and home to some of the wealthiest people on the planet. But a crisis of poverty and homelessness exists alongside this wealth, and it’s only growing worse.

Home ownership is an unreachable dream. Schools are underfunded, and children are being used as pawns for extremist dogma that denies racism and attacks LGBTQ+ students. The climate is only growing hotter and disproportionately impacting the working poor. Our children are gunned down by weapons of war.

**And let’s face it, Peter. Washington is too gridlocked to tackle these challenges with the urgency they deserve – and you better believe a growing right-wing movement is well-equipped to flip California red and send our state backward.**

**I’m running for governor to tackle these crises, move our state forward and empower those without a voice – but I need you with me.[Will you join me by splitting a donation between my campaign and The Collective PAC? We still need to raise another $10,000 to show the strength of this grassroots movement, and it’s your contribution that will get us there.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZobNI0IyJvNQ6wMx-qo2oDxkEAil2luSyUsJAz68Oa4hc6L2AVt1zktQh9qhkjhCU2zdzYlO6k5RnyADs2LyYLz3MByowxNGe4zVtjziG-2rPfx1KkZ8fRrvE3tQRmWN3yrdVNwF0La-ZM5SydnzwXD8jLjRlNrWLpdq4y1Pb_NhhI21hsLqOkNUPeKCm_QsicqLGsdliVODK9ZgVjWbfR2T0oglwwlcCEfj6oKxRxsw1EM_zcKpF6cMoO-dx1cypHjUiMaSgjepcmBCTJ8RCmvnYqvADo8FmSLCUh6HjQXFyfCDCkMk9BFY399ih_g1OU3CD6Y7Ee-iEcKHA1okwregVyjgg_1DaFP0MPCtMmVGocTFXUCObIh5cXotZyvjh/42i/RsNEfciOSi615Y8Km_PzGg/h3/yoDFqmLepP15QoRitwR-JlOwFOOPOUF6nyut4gUINzg)**

My life’s work has been about fighting for a California where everybody has the same opportunities I did.

Together, we can raise the minimum wage and create jobs that pay the bills. We can build additional paths to home ownership, affordable rents and more housing altogether. We can take weapons of war off our streets, transition to cleaner energy faster and build safe, inclusive communities for everybody.

**[So please, will you help me become California’s next governor – and its first Afro-Latino governor – by splitting $10 or whatever you can between my campaign and The Collective PAC? Together, we’ll make this state a place where everyone has the opportunity to succeed.](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z13Gsiw4jYjb8npbjGXirZobNI0IyJvNQ6wMx-qo2oDxkEAil2luSyUsJAz68Oa4hc6L2AVt1zktQh9qhkjhCU2zdzYlO6k5RnyADs2LyYLz3MByowxNGe4zVtjziG-2rPfx1KkZ8fRrvE3tQRmWN3yrdVNwF0La-ZM5SydnzwXEMNaGdvUSW4dHaXOqYGW15bPmCk8GJZCiaScGCTN4jGblAju0DaSyQfrwu1xh2jDgxFYp3raps_1HpQN81rS5ZHUtyfB0JBta_sRbiHw8jl-SRBdQL4efXC0i1-I-m_DNwuVBoNe6iDo6Ta3r8CUd-zaSbS1ZTo5pkWcY20GkND4w-g9slybLLunMYDKJtSbXqWSzs0b7tTlDUYkb-oeNRMIu5AalWCBt0OHxDb3ZDg/42i/RsNEfciOSi615Y8Km_PzGg/h4/bNKQP541K9JPxqSOt8GJp8rTNIHYP1CaH-RKbB2nq3Q)**

Thank you,

Tony

I’m a proud father, Afro-Latino, and long-time public servant who’s fought for Californians on my local school board, city council, in the state assembly and for the last five years as state superintendent – running the largest public education system in America. The importance of service was ingrained in me by my mother, Cecelia. She was an immigrant from Panama and a classroom teacher. When I was just 6 years old, she died tragically, and my brother and I became orphans. We were raised by our cousin. We were poor. We knew what hunger was and had to rely on food stamps. But public education was our great equalizer. It’s what enabled an orphan with no money, power or influence to grab on to opportunities and build a pathway to a better life. I’ve spent my life fighting to ensure all Californians have those opportunities – which is why I’m running to be the next governor of California. Across our country, the very fabric of who we are as a society is being tested. California is the fifth largest economy in the world and home to some of the wealthiest people on the planet. But a crisis of poverty and homelessness exists alongside this wealth, and it’s only growing worse. Home ownership is an unreachable dream. Schools are underfunded, and children are being used as pawns for extremist dogma that denies racism and attacks LGBTQ+ students. The climate is only growing hotter and disproportionately impacting the working poor. Our children are gunned down by weapons of war. And let’s face it, Peter. Washington is too gridlocked to tackle these challenges with the urgency they deserve – and you better believe a growing right-wing movement is well-equipped to flip California red and send our state backward. I’m running for governor to tackle these crises, move our state forward and empower those without a voice – but I need you with me. My life’s work has been about fighting for a California where everybody has the same opportunities I did. Together, we can raise the minimum wage and create jobs that pay the bills. subject: I'm ready to fight back

body:
We’re going to take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and put everyday people in charge of our country. Please let me explain.
#
We’ve accomplished so much together this year, Peter.
From launching this campaign on January 6th to calling out Josh Hawley on cable news to breaking Missouri fundraising records, your support has helped us put a national spotlight on this U.S. Senate race.
**And now, multiple polls are showing that we’re in a neck-and-neck race with Josh Hawley — the GOP’s most unpopular U.S. Senator running in 2024.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to add your first donation of any amount toward my campaign to defeat Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. **But first, please let me share a little more about how we got here.**
**[ADD A DONATION NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
I grew up in mid-Missouri. And like so many other Americans, my family lived paycheck-to-paycheck. So when my little sister was born with a heart condition, the medical bills bankrupted us. Maxed-out credit cards and no money left, times had never been tougher.
But we weren’t alone — our community took care of us. When my parents had to take my sister to the hospital in St. Louis, our neighbors and friends took my siblings and me into their homes and brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. **That’s the Missouri I grew up in.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
Their support helped send me to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything they had done for me and my family growing up. Got deployed to Iraq and Afghanistan. Later the Pentagon. I was on the Joint Staff negotiating arms control agreements with NATO and Russia.
When I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, one of the hardest things was seeing what was happening back in my old neighborhood. It was a community picked for parts — the local corner store boarded up, my first family house bulldozed to the ground. **Here’s all that’s left of it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
While all of us were risking our lives building up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians like Josh Hawley let our country waste away. They spent trillions on bailouts, tax breaks, and subsidies for the industries that stripped our communities for parts — like Wall Street, Big Pharma, and Big Oil — and then told us they can’t figure out how to invest even a fraction of that into building up our own country and investing in our own people.
**I saw what was happening — and I was ready to fight back.**
So in my final year of active duty, I worked to upend the corporate defense monopolies that leave our country less safe. I also joined an organization that fights corporate monopolies — we took on defense contractors, Big Pharma, Big Tech, Big Ag, Wall Street. The people buying off our politicians and leaving the rest of us behind.
**And now, I’m running for U.S. Senate to replace Josh Hawley and fundamentally change who has power in our country** — so everyday people call the shots, not massive corporations or corrupt politicians. I want to abolish corporate PACs, expose lobbyists writing our laws, criminalize war profiteering, ban insider trading among members of Congress, and enact a Marshall Plan for the Midwest — a massive investment and job creation program that will rebuild our forgotten communities and get us off fossil fuels once and for all.
I want to codify Roe v. Wade, secure voting rights, and ban anti-union “Right-to-Work” scams forever. I want to put working people in charge of our country. But I need your help to get it done.
**Without a single cent of corporate PAC money, we’re building the people-powered movement that's going to defeat Josh Hawley and flip this Senate seat — and I need you on our team.[Please add a donation of any amount right now so we can continue building this movement and finally give power back to everyday, working people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=7&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=8&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=9&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
---
I’m not just running to make a point — **this is a race we can win.**
**Josh Hawley is vulnerable.** In 2018, he won his seat with only 51% of the vote — and after he exposed himself to be a fraud and a coward on January 6th, he became the least popular Republican Senator up for re-election in 2024. In Missouri’s last Senate race during a presidential election, the margin was only 2.7%.
Since Hawley was elected, Missourians have broken with him and taken back their power at the ballot box by voting to raise the minimum wage, expand Medicaid through the Affordable Care Act, and legalize cannabis.
TIME Magazine called me the “clean-cut, populist Marine veteran who could give Democrats a fighting chance." And if we’re able to get this message in front of voters early in this race, we have a real shot at defeating Josh Hawley in 2024 and flipping Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
**But I need you on this team to get it done, Peter.** GOP insiders and even Hawley’s own campaign have already started attacking me — and over the coming months, they’re bound to get even more vicious. That’s why we need to start preparing right now to fight back and deliver our positive message to voters.
**[Will you chip in anything you can right now so we can keep building this record-breaking grassroots movement and stay prepared for the fight ahead? I don’t take a cent from corporate PACs, so I mean it when I say anything makes a big difference to our campaign.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40536?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/40535?refcode=em20231228-4481&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=4481%2E614464%2E6CEhyq)
---
Together, we can take back power from corrupt politicians like Josh Hawley and finally put real, everyday people in charge of our country.
Thanks for helping us get it done,
Lucas Kunce

A boy who wanted to be just like his dad and a man who has three children of his own.

A boy whose family worked hard to make ends meet and a man who's running for the U.S. Senate.

Friend, a lot has changed since the 80's, but one thing has stayed the same: I still know that God put me on this earth to serve my country.

My name is Sam Brown. I'm a retired Army Captain, a father, a conservative, and a Christian.

And most recently, I'm a candidate for Nevada's U.S. Senate seat.

But one thing I'm not is a politician -- in fact, I've never held elected office in my life.

That means that I'm not beholden to special interests or corrupt D.C. elites.

**But it also means that I don 't have the big money megadonors that are fueling my opponents' campaigns.**

That's why I'm reaching out to you, Friend.

I don't need special interests to fund our campaign.

I don't need big money megadonors.

I don't need D.C. elites.

**All I need is YOU, Friend.**

Here's how you can help me win this Senate seat:

**1 - Your Prayers:** Running for the U.S. Senate is a tremendous undertaking. It's something that I can't do all by myself. I'd be honored and humbled to be included in your prayers as I take on this tremendous challenge to serve the country I love.

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. #
This isn't the news we wanted to share with you today. But this has serious implications for our ability to continue supporting Democratic candidates so we hope you'll keep reading.
It’s no secret that this quarter has been difficult for political fundraising — the holidays are typically difficult. But we need to be transparent with you:
**In October, our average online donation was $20.72. In November, our average online donation dropped to $16.99. And this month, our average donation has dipped to $14.27.**
While that may not seem like a big deal, for a grassroots-funded organization like ours, this downward trend has had a big impact on our ability to meet our fundraising goals.
So before our FEC fundraising deadline on the 31st, we have two options:
1. Generate a very large number of donations to help us close the gap
2. Ask people to give a larger donation than they have in the past

According to our records associated with dpwillis67@gmail.com, you haven't contributed to the Long Run PAC yet. If today will be the day that you chip in for the first time, it'd make a huge difference if you could make a $10 donation.
How about it?
[**Can you please make a contribution of $10 to the Long Run PAC to stand with Mandela Barnes before our final FEC deadline of 2023? We wouldn't ask if your support wasn't crucial to electing change-making candidates nationwide.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-dec23.PPEU6P&refcode=em231228-1-t3&t=1&akid=5104%2E196590%2EPdwNQS)

Thank you for all you've done, and will continue to do, to build our movement.
\- The team at the Long Run PAC

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

name: Ro Khanna
subject: Thank you
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

I want to take a moment at the end of the year to say thank you. Thank you for your activism, your commitment, and your support in the fight for a better future. A future where all Americans have the chance for the American Dream.

We’re fighting for a future where we can invent it, build it, and buy it in America. A future overflowing with economic opportunity in every corner of this country.

We’re fighting for Medicare For All, $10 a day childcare, affordable housing, free college, social security, safe schools, reproductive freedom, clean air, clean water, and a thriving environment so our children and our children’s children will inherit a better country and a better world.

We’re fighting for a future free of corruption. A future where our democracy isn’t overrun by PAC money and lobbyist money. And where Congress works for We the People, not entrenched special interests.

As Martin Luther King, Jr. reminds us: “The arc of the moral universe is long, but it bends towards justice.”

I need your help to go "three up...three down" against this lineup of liberal career politicians. That's a bit of baseball vernacular. No surprise, right? It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning. Then, it's your team's turn to go on offense. Well, that's very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country. Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years - most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I'm reaching out to you today. **[Will you step up and help strike out this"lineup of liberals" through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=67fccbdf88864c14a99f30c31b702258&_e=ZLig2D4IaFDUpE8awLU2nHMkgz14nRSdX82vw_BltnsPi6aYhcztJ1KGBtRl2spGfhWekJRlfcyOp8CN_NWjrsNpLrsT6R9inrFn4YzKXDv0bguUiLlFHDkfl-fgj-bk7_WtHqfCYXAuKCX2eRwuJZfSItEWhm2uyrW0QkV1YAk8FLgRTUD_H6_qmNBEUGMeL63gRUmD1C7s2vXgBsvEm0-z8pTQywbtxw6jfSjFt529d9cW__ZHzTck_0I7T6AzqZ7v_-Q1W91k10ailOhcwHrJ_QFwy-iE6ajWlRaxJKCKwIEFpPNsgQpwBoClRj6R9aWjAZUs_HXwpnOHRyNuOS1W5Y-DPCcXEysK3rmp72rdqE4iMmQjhbDd-aZFc4_Bd9CxNK13MwXG82M57IrlFQ%3D%3D)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California. Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California. • Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don't lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a "false choice" between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=67fccbdf88864c14a99f30c31b702258&_e=ZLig2D4IaFDUpE8awLU2nHMkgz14nRSdX82vw_BltnsPi6aYhcztJ1KGBtRl2spGfhWekJRlfcyOp8CN_NWjrsNpLrsT6R9inrFn4YzKXDv0bguUiLlFHDkfl-fgj-bk7_WtHqfCYXAuKCX2eRwuJZfSItEWhm2uyrW0QkV1YAk8FLgRTUD_H6_qmNBEUGMeL63gRUmD1C7s2vXgBsvEm0-z8pTQywbtxw6jfSjFt525Dr0zjHnnEHqTRSKEFPyRgUayKmRD7aQ_pfpA0wgmQec4WYJnzvJ5b37Odw6IMOFv8ChcXVxj4Yn5jZrQgi8ayPz_sOKA5TUZ82CH_p9W_3dJ2hKuK_nhwU44PiTVaPrTLaCXLFwbrnnsYueX2t8tg50KawslxChpSf7smiS-sw%3D%3D)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:

1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign "connecting the dots" between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.

Hi there! I’m Ava – Marlene’s daughter.

I’m reaching out because I want you to know why my mom is the best candidate in AZ‐01.

My mom’s passion is to improve Arizona, to make our state and country a better place. I can’t tell you how inspiring it is to me to watch her work every day.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75957500/446255739/-381882994?refcode=em-12.28.23-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYwODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWI2NzQzYjktYTZhNS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=wnhc2W8fJN58PMF5GHhmRKtykWIFu7jTKI9wjPDDTSs=) _My parents brought me into our family from Guatemala nearly 20 years ago_
Every day I become more aware of issues facing Arizonans and families like mine and yours. I’m worried about how Republicans like my mom’s opponent David Schweikert are controlling my and my friends’ bodies. I worry about the future of our democracy.

My mom has an incredible story. My grandparents fled communist Cuba to give her and my aunt and uncle a better life. She was an amazing broadcast journalist for 20 years, then she worked hard to help the most disadvantaged in our community. So, it doesn’t surprise me that she is determined to go to Washington DC to continue fighting for the little guy.

Whatever happens, I’m just so proud of my mom. Take it from me – she would make an amazing representative and treat everyone fairly and with respect.

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

The American people, including 80% of Democratic voters, are demanding a ceasefire. We’re done watching our government support cutting off food, water, electricity, and medical care to millions of people with nowhere to go. Thanks to Biden, the U.S. has vetoed and watered down UN Security Council resolutions for a ceasefire and humanitarian aid. And he’s still trying to send $14 billion of our tax dollars to Israel’s military, without any conditions on upholding human rights. One of my top priorities in Congress is protecting water as a human right. No family should ever have to go without access to something as fundamental as water—whether in my district, my family’s homeland, or anywhere.

UNICEF’s Executive Director said: “Access to sufficient amounts of clean water is a matter of life and death, and children in Gaza have barely a drop to drink.” She blamed “the constant bombing, along with the restrictions on materials and fuel allowed into the territory.”
Human Rights Watch just accused Israel’s government of using starvation as a weapon of war.
“It doesn’t get any worse,’” said the World Food Programme’s chief economist, who noted: “I have never seen something at the scale that is happening in Gaza and at this speed.”
Hundreds of thousands of children in Gaza are suffering from diseases related to malnutrition, lack of clean water, and displacement. They can’t get healthcare or medical supplies because of the bombing and the blockade.
This is an intensification of the Israeli government’s years-long blockade on Gaza. In Gaza and the West Bank, Israel’s government restricts Palestinians’ access to water, electricity, and medical care.
I remember going through checkpoints with my grandmother as the Israeli military interrogated and segregated her, simply for trying to seek services such as healthcare.
Achieving a just and lasting peace—where Israelis and Palestinians have equal rights and freedoms, and where no person lives in fear for their safety—requires ending the blockade, occupation, and dehumanizing system of apartheid.

clean_body: Palestinians deserve safety and freedom, like all humans. | | | Friend, Instead of working for a just and lasting ceasefire, President Biden and his administration have bypassed Congress in order to hand over weapons and bombs to the Israeli government—as it carries out war crimes and massacres Palestinians. The American people, including 80% of Democratic voters, are demanding a ceasefire. We’re done watching our government support cutting off food, water, electricity, and medical care to millions of people with nowhere to go. Thanks to Biden, the U.S. has vetoed and watered down UN Security Council resolutions for a ceasefire and humanitarian aid. And he’s still trying to send $14 billion of our tax dollars to Israel’s military, without any conditions on upholding human rights. | One of my top priorities in Congress is protecting water as a human right. No family should ever have to go without access to something as fundamental as water—whether in my district, my family’s homeland, or anywhere. UNICEF’s Executive Director said: “Access to sufficient amounts of clean water is a matter of life and death, and children in Gaza have barely a drop to drink.” She blamed “the constant bombing, along with the restrictions on materials and fuel allowed into the territory.” Human Rights Watch just accused Israel’s government of using starvation as a weapon of war. “It doesn’t get any worse,’” said the World Food Programme’s chief economist, who noted: “I have never seen something at the scale that is happening in Gaza and at this speed.” Hundreds of thousands of children in Gaza are suffering from diseases related to malnutrition, lack of clean water, and displacement. They can’t get healthcare or medical supplies because of the bombing and the blockade. This is an intensification of the Israeli government’s years-long blockade on Gaza. In Gaza and the West Bank, Israel’s government restricts Palestinians’ access to water, electricity, and medical care. I remember going through checkpoints with my grandmother as the Israeli military interrogated and segregated her, simply for trying to seek services such as healthcare. Achieving a just and lasting peace—where Israelis and Palestinians have equal rights and freedoms, and where no person lives in fear for their safety—requires ending the blockade, occupation, and dehumanizing system of apartheid. Thank you for being part of our growing movement for peace and equality. Peter,
Make no mistake: our opponent, Mitch McConnell, and national Republicans are going to pull out all the stops to flip Pennsylvania. Their determination to win PA’s Senate seat could make this the most expensive race in the country.
It’s a rare privilege to serve the people of our Commonwealth in the U.S. Senate, and I don’t take this responsibility for granted. Pennsylvanians deserve a Senator in Washington working for them and their families. It is an honor that they’ve trusted me to do just that.
It’s why we’re working so hard to ensure that we can compete with the flood of dark money the other side is planning to spend against us.

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=862673c33ff24eca88d4b4378c35accd&_e=qxjyZOLULAKb_dmROzCGa9aaLUqpvy5d0MwtuRaVKBhFokS_ztT12xyl1R6zi8DoHZ9NiRoF7vkAFSpX5f0qf0h6Hs0OMJz4hU4QzpRc4gFwgDG7HpoJhg7h__66luj-EsTkgCaBHFtUzDEUH8ZAG68GoTarDuPbUALEqx2N3CnFEOD5VaAW1eYOql0mVAUYcw1INotl1EgoSvd2-G1uOGTtXTvTt618Ca2SjyDQA8wLFr7KZLRvmCgclnpsuDlRuC9rsoEiM8JdKRs-gI4x1ZrUFrDDyE4gvVsaFb2BgnX96Zh8cOh9iUHwDqWQH_ve7z4USB8vm14MwGoG2IkwnQXVzQ1tklIuVJeDUfeDuYmjYy1yRE8AVjdZEv0JJu8XFlS173Du2YW01Pq8Guq7DA%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=862673c33ff24eca88d4b4378c35accd&_e=qxjyZOLULAKb_dmROzCGa9aaLUqpvy5d0MwtuRaVKBhFokS_ztT12xyl1R6zi8DoHZ9NiRoF7vkAFSpX5f0qf0h6Hs0OMJz4hU4QzpRc4gFwgDG7HpoJhg7h__66luj-EsTkgCaBHFtUzDEUH8ZAG68GoTarDuPbUALEqx2N3CnFEOD5VaAW1eYOql0mVAUYcw1INotl1EgoSvd2-G1uOGTtXTvTt618Ca2SjyDQA8wyvtcWG29-Oi9K-LF6t6LMc4VYhRdxthZdSEShp9TyVm6kYKtO9DPYPtaWqWbpk55WzVi20Kli76LTm0IZEjSnx_sftB2MLext9P7k6Uyl9JT9ArdzRZBchPd8k2V0pccADhEkCp1al5UT9X8VJ4XgyH7zsolN-g8mFHoMk_WbnQ%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=862673c33ff24eca88d4b4378c35accd&_e=qxjyZOLULAKb_dmROzCGa9aaLUqpvy5d0MwtuRaVKBhFokS_ztT12xyl1R6zi8DoHZ9NiRoF7vkAFSpX5f0qf0h6Hs0OMJz4hU4QzpRc4gFwgDG7HpoJhg7h__66luj-EsTkgCaBHFtUzDEUH8ZAG68GoTarDuPbUALEqx2N3CnFEOD5VaAW1eYOql0mVAUYcw1INotl1EgoSvd2-G1uOGTtXTvTt618Ca2SjyDQA8wc3gXimI4qIlNaFqpJm17hjN7vxymV9F9CY1cvTWcQVnKKIkt9riCb-ZSujZ_fksZZ_P0AtYk_4mv9m2BzF1IVSict8JT-9pjDIa9r4ysAqIY52RW03Ufx0Et3lfcdGJxTmrVk_j-jWUGZjuKbfmgIwgRjxhXrgy91kjuDv0MSwg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

The best antidote to bad information is good information. We will never compromise our values just to drive clicks and profit. 3. We will deliver our news to the online spaces where people spend their time. Social media newsfeeds. Inboxes. Search engines. By bringing quality journalism to the online spaces where misinformation is thriving, our reporting dismantles right-wing propaganda in real time before it can spread. Right now, our newsrooms across ten battleground states (with more to come) are committed to reporting the facts on the issues that matter and calling out and combating misinformation wherever we see it. | In 2023, the House of Representatives has seen a record number of retirements. It’s no surprise–From an insurrection to House Speaker chaos and members like George Santos and Marjorie Taylor Greene who undermine the integrity of our work with political theater every day, to threats on the personal safety of members and their families, it’s enough to make people want to throw their hands up and walk away.

_**However, my foremost commitment remains to deliver tangible outcomes for our community.**_ I don’t let the extremist’s noise and antics get in the way. Whether it's reducing healthcare expenses, safeguarding reproductive rights, or advocating for LGBTQ equality, I channel all my efforts into achieving real results.

Hey team, it's Makenzie again. Ilhan's finance director.
I'm reaching out because late last week, I made a very difficult decision during our campaign budget meeting, and as a supporter of this campaign, I thought you deserved to know about it.
It's become clear that in order to continue growing our progressive coalition all across the country and have the resources required to take on the right wing's super PACs, we're going to need to scale up our investments in digital organizing and advertising.
The money wasn't in our December budget. But I gave the green light anyway.
It was a risk, for sure. But right now, as we face our final FEC deadline of the year and the right wing is watching our every move, we need to do _whatever it takes_ to set our campaign up for success in 2024.
So I made a bet that if I asked, you'd come through and help us fill the gap. And I’m really hoping you will. For Ilhan. And for everyone who cares about continuing our progressive movement's fight in Congress and beyond.
**[So please: Can you make your first online contribution — of $3 or anything you can— to Ilhan's campaign for Congress today? Every donation will go a long way toward filling our budget gap as we make critical investments in this campaign.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-dec23.Lgr9Ln&refcode=em231228-1-t3&t=2&akid=822%2E791427%2EMNQ6zt)
Like I said, this was a tough call. But one of the things that makes Ilhan different from most of her colleagues in Washington is the tens of thousands of grassroots donors who she can count on when it matters most.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
Makenzie Richardson

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner. Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963. Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company. Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce. body:
Your participation in Hillsdale College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is requested.

| | |
---
| This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6b84c4e418d346edb008e044675aad33&_e=uqowvlk6BlvzCt4mHpRnmvn9dM3HsbR_xcDDa1dFglDPydhjBqHlGPyaLhLRrh83mDPLUiTVbC47aVoCG-zUAjcqTC89LDgeqNR5CNbpiedIN6f2t3Wga6avLgHuT5QLeByrW1UvMOfR7sciXCtoHZCwmCELmz22nJt1w6b6waBqw61-hDNL94fYcqv6jGpqoJeElzPP1cFajSKW9S_h4aMuvwfZT96-uNcjxChqEABPRdg4TNU06K3-YBBBKQAHZ0fe1WIYcT4h5WCE9Tfe4m_9-X9B-o1HzwpcY13db37f0o4H4UvLflb_JPJtfNBZpVxybDv25rdqINsF7vPqZEPOqMjkqlnWZfNjx_M5QetvMeH6SAv4qPn5a-dCN2GlB6y1hkB6-zXKs6f4CAH2aw%3D%3D)

| | | Dear Friend, Your participation in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** is requested.

Your response will only take a few minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the bench.
## Do you agree that the role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6b84c4e418d346edb008e044675aad33&_e=uqowvlk6BlvzCt4mHpRnmvn9dM3HsbR_xcDDa1dFglDPydhjBqHlGPyaLhLRrh83mDPLUiTVbC47aVoCG-zUAjcqTC89LDgeqNR5CNbpiedIN6f2t3Wga6avLgHuT5QLeByrW1UvMOfR7sciXCtoHZCwmCELmz22nJt1w6b6waBqw61-hDNL94fYcqv6jGpqoJeElzPP1cFajSKW9S_h4aMuvwfZT96-uNcjxChqEABPRdg4TNU06K3-YBBBKQAHS-pCkOw9e5Y-yW4YTPw5gKCoDuftKCO_vO5TuoMDxzWQa7QAhneKkD7Rs7jFK-PSYqUvFwlzO9TLK-MbJGs8QRRvwk4M7DpGmQ-X6IuGNMCUFItMlSivuKNNt5p_mmlPhGEBW4cndcwNF8_-06zhhQ%3D%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6b84c4e418d346edb008e044675aad33&_e=uqowvlk6BlvzCt4mHpRnmvn9dM3HsbR_xcDDa1dFglDPydhjBqHlGPyaLhLRrh83mDPLUiTVbC47aVoCG-zUAjcqTC89LDgeqNR5CNbpiedIN6f2t3Wga6avLgHuT5QLeByrW1UvMOfR7sciXCtoHZCwmCELmz22nJt1w6b6waBqw61-hDNL94fYcqv6jGpqoJeElzPP1cFajSKW9S_h4aMuvwfZT96-uNcjxChqEABPRdg4TNU06K3-YBBBKQAHkieiSDLo9nODHyJNJNDCiwBFTWltBBmUNtH2xbzn0nr10vQzT_EdJYh5o0CdBfU63gnWht4CIqYl655J9-gzAdaasDYnEwBH_0GeN-EnVR93m-t-dxJkkabDF3iD0KI_Ts5MFn3-YERdSvujozy6yA%3D%3D) Even worse, progressives dismayed by recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put it in a _Boston Globe_ op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by four or more seats."

What is your opinion about the Supreme Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me using the College's **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the proper role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution instead of legislating from the bench.

You can easily complete your **National Survey on the United States Supreme Court** using this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/supreme-court-survey](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6b84c4e418d346edb008e044675aad33&_e=uqowvlk6BlvzCt4mHpRnmvn9dM3HsbR_xcDDa1dFglDPydhjBqHlGPyaLhLRrh83mDPLUiTVbC47aVoCG-zUAjcqTC89LDgeqNR5CNbpiedIN6f2t3Wga6avLgHuT5QLeByrW1UvMOfR7sciXCtoHZCwmCELmz22nJt1w6b6waBqw61-hDNL94fYcqv6jGpqoJeElzPP1cFajSKW9S_h4aMuvwfZT96-uNcjxChqEABPRdg4TNU06K3-YBBBKQAHB6_d-XsN0-VcoxkmZ8PBL7OdAOfYWbf6xljiHDd57H66HZSIg2w1-8aHf0BrlHko2oeUNzP6TY6CWxTCwKRp-z9D4OFcdHnGZIbzszb9ZAEqTlg4LT6KVTpaqLwpAZcqlTuf--nhtZWgQBpRa1wRgQ%3D%3D)**

And after you give your views, I hope you will consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

The failure of too many of America's schools to provide young people with a proper education in American history and government makes it easier for progressives to **undermine** the separation of powers at the heart of limited government.

I'm sure you agree that too many Americans do not understand the role of an independent judiciary in preserving our constitutional order.

That's why Hillsdale College has expanded its educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly **reaching** and **teaching** millions of Americans in all 50 states--including yours!

These efforts counter the influence of anti-American ideology being taught in classrooms all across America.

Your support will help us to expand our educational outreach, including:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101: The Meaning and History of the Constitution" and "The U.S. Supreme Court."

* **Reaching** over six million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty.

* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens, teachers, and students in K-12 schools across America.

* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education by launching and providing ongoing guidance to over 70 classical K-12 charter schools nationwide that offer a strong American history and civics curriculum.

We **undertake our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty** --as we do all of our work--without accepting a penny of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Friend,
I hope that you’ve been able to enjoy holiday celebrations with family and friends! I also wanted to make sure this email didn’t get lost in your inbox – the Wisconsin Supreme Court’s new maps ruling means that we could finally have fair maps in Wisconsin for 2024.
The only thing we know for certain is that we have a real chance to end the unfair GOP majority **and** an unprecedented 2024 election cycle ahead of us.
Friend, the WI Senate Democrats is one of the biggest sources of financial support for senate candidates, and we need to get a fundraising head start now to support all candidates next year.
That’s why we’ve set an ambitious New Maps Digital Goal of $33,000 by the end of the year. Friend, will you chip in $33 or whatever you’re able today to help us protect our incumbent candidates and flip the new seats?
